text: Invitations sent to valid addresses never arrive, although the system says delivered. We need the invitation delivery fixed.
The invite dialog functions properly, but people repeatedly mistake the cancel button for send. Please improve the visual hierarchy.
Offline editing is already advertised, but reconnecting discards offline changes. Please repair the existing synchronization.
I am not asking for another feature. I want the current feature included in the basic plan rather than sold as an add-on.
We need offline editing, which is not offered. Please add this capability for trips without internet.
The existing version history is complete and correct, but its dates are difficult to scan. Please improve the layout.
Could you add a connector for our inventory system? We currently copy the data manually because no connector exists.
The error message says operation 47 failed. Please explain the issue and the next step in ordinary language.
Our saved report disappeared after we refreshed the page. We need saved work to survive a refresh.
The editor duplicates the last paragraph whenever I reopen a saved document. Please stop changing the content.
The search results are correct, but the filter labels make no sense to new staff. Please rename them using terms our team understands.
Please add a way to schedule recurring reports. At present reports can only be generated manually.
Please stop counting unaccepted invitations as paid seats. The charge policy is the issue.
Please allow unused monthly credits to carry over rather than charging for a fresh allocation.
The import works, but the successful completion message appears far below the visible area. Please make the result easy to find.
Please add an option to invite an entire group from a saved list; only individual invitations exist today.
Please add version history so we can inspect prior drafts. The app currently keeps only the latest draft.
We need a new approval workflow with two reviewers; the product currently has no approval feature.
Please make offline editing available on the current plan without requiring the higher-priced subscription.
Can you support importing contacts from a calendar service? That integration is not available today.
It takes seven clicks to reach the existing export option. Please put a shortcut near the table.
The file upload reports success but stores a zero-byte file. Please preserve the uploaded content.
We need a monthly billing option; paying the entire year upfront is the problem, not the product behavior.
Version history claims to retain every draft but silently omits edits made offline. Please fix that data loss.
The offline status is technically accurate, but the tiny icon is easy to miss. Please make connection state more obvious.
We use the product happily but need a cheaper annual plan for seasonal staff.
The per-seat surcharge makes our small volunteer team unable to afford the plan. Please change the seat pricing.
Notifications arrive hours after the event despite the stated immediate-delivery behavior. We need the existing alerts to work on time.
The mobile app crashes when I open a perfectly valid attachment. Please fix the crash.
Please introduce a dark theme. There is currently only a light theme and no display preference.
Everything works by mouse, but navigating the existing form with a keyboard takes an unnecessarily confusing route. Please improve the tab order.
Version history is the only paid add-on we use. Could you lower its additional price?
